label: bug
file: src/util/dates.ts

`startOfWeek(d, tz)` takes a time zone parameter but never uses it — the TODO comment even admits it ("TODO: honour tz"). It computes the week boundary purely from the UTC date/time. For a user in Sydney (UTC+10/+11), the UTC-based "start of week" instant lands on what is already Tuesday local time in some cases, while for London (UTC+0/+1) it coincides with Monday, which is why the scheduling/send logic that relies on this function produces the day offset the reporter sees.
